title: Change status
purpose: Move a ticket to another status: waiting, resolved with a summary, reopened with a reason, or closed.
summary: Set the ticket's status. Resolving needs a resolution summary, reopening a resolved ticket needs a reason, and closing only follows resolving.

tasks.title: Wait on the client or a third party
steps: Choose [[Waiting on client]] or [[Waiting on third party]] under [[New status]] and select [[Change status]].

tasks.title: Resolve a ticket
steps: Write what was done in [[Resolution summary]], then select [[Change status]]. The summary is internal.

tasks.title: Close a resolved ticket
steps: Choose [[Closed]] under [[New status]] and select [[Change status]]. To close several at once, use the Tickets list.

tasks.title: Reopen a resolved ticket
steps: Choose [[Open (reopen)]], or a waiting status marked (reopen), under [[New status]].

good_to_know: Closed is final. A closed ticket cannot change status again, and this page is refused for it.
A complaint closes only after its independent review. The page refuses the close until a supervisor has reviewed it.
Closed follows Resolved only. Resolve first; the form offers Closed only on a resolved ticket.
The client does not see the resolution summary.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: Opens from the ticket page, as a dialog or a full page. Any active staff role who may read the ticket may change its status. The form remembers the version of the ticket you opened; if it changed since, saving is refused and you reload.

items.label: New status
items.description: Required. The choices depend on the current status. From Open or a waiting status: Open or the other waiting status, and Resolved; the current status is not offered, and Closed is not offered. From Resolved: Closed, Open (reopen), Waiting on client (reopen) and Waiting on third party (reopen).

items.label: Resolution summary
items.description: Required when you choose Resolved: what was done. Internal; shown on the ticket page as Resolution. Ignored for other statuses.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required when reopening a resolved ticket (any status other than Closed chosen from Resolved). Optional in other cases; kept in the audit history.

items.label: Change status
items.description: Saves and confirms Status changed. The ticket page shows the new status and a timeline event.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the ticket without changing anything.

items.label: Resolved
items.description: Needs a resolution summary. Resolving records the time. A resolved ticket can be closed by staff or reopened with a reason.

items.label: Closed
items.description: Only a resolved ticket can be closed. A complaint must have its independent review first ("This complaint closes only after a supervisor has reviewed it."). A closed ticket cannot be reopened or changed; raise a new ticket and mention the earlier number.

items.label: Waiting statuses
items.description: Waiting on client means the client owes an answer or material; Waiting on third party means an outsider owes the next step. The ticket keeps its team and assignee. Whether either pauses a service clock is decided by the laboratory's service targets, when they are configured.

items.label: From the composer
items.description: The composer on the ticket page can also set Open or a waiting status together with a reply or note; it cannot resolve or close.

items.label: Client replies
items.description: A client's reply on a ticket that waits on the client, or is resolved, reopens it. That is automatic and not a staff action.
